subject: general
question: India recently assumed the Chairmanship of which organisation from Bangladesh during the 13th Governing Council Meeting held in Malé, Maldives?

options.text: South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC)
Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation (BIMSTEC)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Bay of Bengal Inter-Governmental Organisation (BOBP-IGO)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India assumed the chairmanship of the **Bay of Bengal Inter-Governmental Organisation (BOBP-IGO)** during the 13th Governing Council Meeting held in Malé, Maldives.
 
• The BOBP-IGO is an intergovernmental organisation established in 2003 to promote fisheries development and management in the Bay of Bengal region.
 
• India succeeded Bangladesh as Chair during this meeting, marking a pivotal moment for regional cooperation in sustainable fisheries management.
 
• The organisation focuses on enhancing cooperation among member countries, including India, Bangladesh, Maldives, and Sri Lanka.
 
• Its objectives include ensuring sustainable fisheries, improving livelihoods of fisher communities, and facilitating capacity building and knowledge sharing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bay of Bengal Region:**

 
 
• The Bay of Bengal is the largest bay in the world, bordered by India, Bangladesh, Myanmar, Sri Lanka, and the Maldives.
 
• It plays a critical role in regional trade, fisheries, and biodiversity conservation.
 
• The region is home to diverse marine species and ecosystems, but faces challenges like overfishing and marine pollution.
 
 
 
• **BOBP-IGO Mandate:**
 
 
• The organisation works to improve fisheries governance and promote sustainable fishing practices.
 
• It conducts training programs, workshops, and research to enhance the capacity of member countries in fisheries management.
 
• BOBP-IGO aims to strengthen regional collaboration for addressing common challenges in fisheries and coastal management.
 
 
 
• **Regional Cooperation:**
 
 
• India plays a key role in promoting regional cooperation through organisations like SAARC, BIMSTEC, and BOBP-IGO.
 
• Collaboration among member states is vital for tackling issues like climate change, food security, and maritime safety.
 
• Efforts by BOBP-IGO align with broader initiatives for sustainable development in the Bay of Bengal region.
 
 
 
• **Challenges in Fisheries Sector:**
 
 
• Overfishing, habitat destruction, and climate change are major concerns impacting fisheries in the Bay of Bengal.
 
• BOBP-IGO supports member nations in developing strategies to address these issues effectively.
 
• Promoting responsible fishing and conservation of marine resources are central to the organisation’s goals.
